svg.text: from ground ice to a cast ice arch · schematic, not to scale
hot water melts ground ice; a pump lifts the meltwater
reheats injection water; meltwater is filtered
well field to the tower base, ≈ 130 m
at the foot of the pumping tower
a robot on the boom plugs the hose in
liner filled in stages; the arch freezes in ≈ 6 sols
